sonnet.problem: This story card retells verse 18 ('yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!'), which choice card 7 just asked about and answered. It adds no new part of the passage and works as a recap of the answer the baker just gave.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'Mountains that seemed to last forever fall, but Habakkuk says God's ways are ___.' The phrase 'last forever' sets up the contrast and hands the baker the answer 'everlasting'. It is a form of the answer.
sonnet.rule: A choice card's question never holds its own answer, or a form of it, like "rock badgers" for "in the rocks." Ask something else.
